preconditions: Non-production tenant or isolated local fixture; synthetic records only; Include one malformed record and verify quarantine or clear failure without silent loss. Safety boundary: Use disposable synthetic repositories and mock integrations only. Never expose real credentials, modify production repositories, or publish/merge changes during a test run.
test_steps: 1. Create a disposable, versioned synthetic fixture: Include one malformed record and verify quarantine or clear failure without silent loss. 2. Execute the platform workflow to audit review and observability access. 3. Capture the committed result, resource version, or run status. 4. Compare the result with the source fixture and the declared invariant. 5. Repeat or recover the operation when applicable; verify access, audit evidence, and side effects.
